name: riftline
description: Riftline – a 3D arena roguelite shooter for the browser (three.js, WebAudio), playable on desktop and on phones and tablets in landscape.

scripts.test: node tests/sim-node.mjs && node tests/save-node.mjs && node build.js && node tools/qa.js deep-test && node tools/qa.js full-qa files && node tools/qa.js full-qa offline && node tools/qa.js data-audit && node tools/qa.js determinism
scripts.audit: node build.js && node tools/qa.js world-audit && node tools/qa.js data-audit && node tools/qa.js run-audit
scripts.screens: node build.js && node tools/qa.js screens pc && node tools/qa.js screens land && node tools/qa.js biome-shots pc && node tools/qa.js biome-shots land && node tools/qa.js attack-shots pc
